Digital prototype. Print files are present, but physical fit, hanging load, seed flow and weather resistance still need testing. These are downloads, not a finished feeder for sale.

THE PRACTICAL PART

Refill. Clean. Repeat.

Unhang, release roof hooks, lift roof, pour into printed central seed chamber, then re-engage hooks.

Seed choice matters: the documented lattice openings are 2.4 × 10 mm. Trial a small dry seed portion before leaving a filled feeder outside.

What you need

A suitable printer, compatible filament, and appropriate outdoor suspension hardware. The integral eye suspends the assembled feeder; the cord or support is not a printed part. No camera, batteries, app or subscription are needed.

Supplied 3MF filament type: PETG. ASA is an outdoor alternative, not a drop-in profile substitution: change the profile, re-slice and test the fit. Use manufacturer ventilation guidance.

Download editable source ZIP

Assembly sequence

  1. Seat printed seed chamber between tray locating rings.
  2. Press frame onto four tray snap hooks until all receiver windows engage.
  3. Press roof onto upper frame hooks; inspect each hook through release window.
  4. Suspend completed rigid assembly only from the integral top eye.

Part-specific support notes

  • Drained landing tray
    None; upright
  • Architectural load frame
    Build-plate supports under the lower cornice; keep all snap flexure slots clear
  • Printed mesh seed chamber
    None; upright
  • Snap weather roof and hanger
    Local support under eaves and eye; remove before assembly

Before hanging it outdoors

  • Digital prototype: snap flexure, weather resistance and suspended load require physical qualification.
  • Four physical parts and at most three colors; color relief belongs to the structural part.
  • Integral 2.4 mm drains. Mesh apertures 2.4 x 10 mm; use seed blend that does not spill through them.
  • 0.6 mm total socket clearance; 22 mm cantilevers are 1.6 mm thick.
  • Seed chamber is positively captive between tray locating rings and locked roof; remove roof to refill and tray for cleaning.

Use shallow daily portions, remove wet seed, keep drains open, and inspect joints and suspension points. Test near the ground before installing over people, pets or property.
